name: react-native-expo
description: Minimal Expo app instrumented with PostHog error tracking. `pnpm sourcemaps` exports the hermes bundles with Expo's built-in debug ids and uploads them with the local posthog-cli, exercising the hermes path that adopts a map's `debugId` as the chunk id.

scripts.sourcemaps: pnpm clean && pnpm export && pnpm upload
